name: Lockup closes on a red CTA pill
looks: The app's rounded-square mark settles beside its wordmark on a soft ground, a dark rounded CTA button in the accent colour arriving last with the site address inside it.
build: Mark and wordmark arrive together (`y:10px -> 0`, power2.out, ~300ms); the CTA button lands with a small scale overshoot (0.95 -> 1.02 -> 1), its label already the full "start free at ..." phrase rather than a generic "get started."
sound: A soft low swell under the lockup's arrival, a confident pop on the CTA button.
prompt: Settle a mark beside its wordmark on a soft ground, then land a confident, accent-coloured CTA button last with the site address written directly into its label, closing the film on one clear, specific action.
